title: Maintain incremental Unreleased notes without release machinery

rubric.text: Uses beta01-to-HEAD as the incremental baseline. Preserves curated wording except the requested citation and credit, links the retry entry to PR #51 with guest-one profile credit, and gives the Unicode fix its own entry linked to PR #52 without unnecessary maintainer credit. Omits internal-only work and preserves the expanded active prerelease history. Reports scope and actual notes/diff; does not impose version selection, Kotlin publication prerequisites, Metalava or release approval.
